## 2026-11-07 13:45 ET (Mac Studio slowdown — Joshua: "computer is running super slow ... put in processes to fix it")

- **Cause:** CPU pinned at 100% / 0% idle, load avg ~260, 10 GB swap. Google Drive at 107–196% CPU (26 h of CPU time this boot) because Drive backs up ALL of ~/Documents ("My Mac" sync) and was endlessly re-uploading the 8.2 GB `Unified Search/index.db` (rewritten on every refresh) plus the door counters' per-second `dets/` logs and ~16k evidence/audit JPEGs; on top of 10 live camera agents (5 door counters ~80–130% each, 5 conduct-watch ~20% each) running at normal priority against Bravo/Parallels/Claude.
- **Fix 1 — data out of Drive/iCloud sync (`bin/sync_relocate.sh`, NEW, allow-listed):** moved `Unified Search/index.db` and `Store Traffic Counter/{dets,tracks,audit,evidence}` to `~/.vp-studio/offsync/<group>/` with a symlink left at each old path, so no script changes. Idempotent; files still open by a process are deferred; whole-dir renames out of Documents hit EDEADLK so dirs move file by file. Host jobs `20261107-1345-cpuguard-relocate`, `20261107-1400-relocate-dirs`; verified counters keep writing dets through the symlink (WAY 13:29). Drive CPU fell to ~25–100% while it reconciles.
- **Fix 2 — camera agents yield to the business apps:** `Nice 10` + `LowPriorityIO` added to the 10 plists `fleet/com.valleypawn.{storetraffic,conductwatch}-<store>.plist` (backups `.bak-pre-nice-20261107`). Running agents reniced live. Plists reload automatically the first time NO camera agent is running (after close / Sunday) via cpu-guard's one-shot `fleet/state/cpu_guard/pending_reload`, so no store loses counting time.
- **Fix 3 — NEW native agent `com.valleypawn.cpu-guard`** (`bin/cpu_guard.sh`, every 5 min, live flag `fleet/state/native_live/cpu-guard`): (a) re-nices any camera agent back to 10 after a restart; (b) any process >150% CPU for 30 min (camera agents/VM/WindowServer excepted) → one FAILURE_LEDGER row per process per day; (c) hourly: re-runs sync_relocate and flags any >500 MB file changing inside ~/Documents (Drive temp `.tmp.driveupload` ignored) → one ledger row per path per week. Status page `fleet/CPU_GUARD.md`. No Slack, no DMs.
- Allow-list += cpu_guard.sh, sync_relocate.sh (backup `fleet/_backups/host_queue_allowlist.txt.bak-pre-cpuguard-20261107`).
- 17:35 check: Google Drive off the top-CPU list; Drive copy of index.db untouched since 11/6 (no more re-uploads). Backblaze briefly busy uploading the relocated files (one-time). cpu-guard state/status writes changed to avoid iCloud "hot 2.txt"/"CPU_GUARD 2.md" conflict copies (snapshots now in ~/.vp-studio/cpu-guard; status written in place); conflict copies moved to fleet/state/cpu_guard/_to_delete/. Plist reload waits for LEX/HAR (close 18:00 Sat).
- **Rule for new agents:** high-churn machine data (indexes, per-frame logs, image dumps, caches) never lives under ~/Documents — put it in `~/.vp-studio/` (Conduct Watch already did this). Remaining load floor while stores are open is the 5 door counters (~4 cores, video decode); the M5 Ultra (mid-Dec) removes it.

Verified the 10 raw export files on disk still matched each result.json's recorded size exactly and were not overwritten by anything that ran later (t12m-current/t12m-prior were the last two windows, each with a once-only end-date filename), then copied them to the sidecar by hand — a plain file copy of data Bravo had already produced, no Bravo/Parallels automation run or re-triggered. All 30/30 now staged; `Valley Pawn OS/monthly-analytics/2026-10 Prestage.md` rewritten COMPLETE 30/30 ahead of the 01:45 ET `monthly-analytics-report` run. FAILURE_LEDGER row RECOVERED.
- **Hazard found, not yet fixed:** `bin/monthly_prestage_runner.py` resolves `HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")` and builds every path from it (`~/Documents/Claude/Projects/...`) with no `/mnt/<folder>` awareness. Run directly from a Cowork device-bridge session (as opposed to natively via launchd on the Mac), `~` resolves to the session's own sandbox home, not `/Users/joshuadavis` — `--dry-run` from this session wrongly reported `0/5 already staged` on every window even though all 30 sidecar files existed. A real (non-dry-run) invocation from a device-bridge session would not have found anything staged and would have dropped a fresh duplicate set of 6 Bravo triggers on top of whatever the native launchd agent was/had done — a real contention and double-posting risk. **Rule for any future session:** never invoke `monthly_prestage_runner.py` (or any script under `Valley Pawn OS/bin/` that assumes it runs natively on the Mac) directly via `device_bash`/Cowork without first checking whether it does its own `HOME`/path resolution — prefer the Host Job Queue (`fleet/host_queue/`) for anything that must execute with the Mac's real `~`, or hand-verify/hand-write the output the way this pass did when the work is a pure file operation on data that already exists. Not fixed in the script itself this pass (additive-only; a path-prefix fix is a candidate for the next session that touches this file).
